requirements.text: Render the authoritative platform Phase 40 Direct ceilings into an immutable reference-worker environment ConfigMap.
Require a complete trusted Phase 40 ceiling environment before direct-bgp execution begins.
Permit per-job Direct limits only as sub-ceilings and reject any requested escalation.
Enforce candidate-space and exact-partition cross-field safety at the worker runtime boundary.
Bound HermiT concurrency by CPU parallelism visible to the worker.
When a finite cgroup memory limit is visible, reserve at least 20 percent non-JVM-heap headroom.
Enforce maxExactPartitions inside the exact coordinator rather than relying on the previous compile-time constant alone.
Enforce the authoritative certificate byte ceiling before an exact certificate is returned.
Enforce the authoritative proof-support-ID ceiling before proof/certificate construction.
Keep operator and distributed-operator ConfigMap propagation explicitly deferred to Phase 40.13.
Preserve every Phase 40.10 parent payload file unless checksum-accounted in the Phase 40.10 to 40.11 inheritance record.
Keep full OWL Direct standards claims disabled until cumulative/native/W3C qualification is complete.
